name: Aroha Renata
bio:
Aroha Renata's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, rerouting from a promising career in supply chain management. While working on logistics for large construction projects, a chance encounter with a local racing team sparked a fascination. She quickly realized her organizational skills and knack for problem-solving could be invaluable in the fast-paced world of racing.

Aroha brings a no-nonsense attitude to her role as Logistics Coordinator for ART Grand Prix Academy. She thrives on the challenge of coordinating complex international shipments, ensuring equipment and personnel are where they need to be, when they need to be there. Her meticulous planning and proactive communication have earned her the respect of the team. She is known for her ability to anticipate potential problems and implement solutions before they impact track performance. What sets Aroha apart is her resourceful creativity; she can find innovative solutions to logistical nightmares when others hit dead ends.

physical.hairStyle: long, wavy, often pulled back into a practical bun
physical.description: Aroha is a sturdy woman of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting everything.
Has a specific brand of tea she insists on having available at all times.
Uses color-coded labels for every single piece of equipment.
